texto: To propose something: **Ich schlage vor, dass …** (I propose that) or **Ich würde vorschlagen, …** (I would propose). With «dass» the verb goes to the end: **Ich schlage vor, dass wir früher anfangen** (I propose that we start before).
To close a text: **Abschließend möchte ich betonen, dass …** (to conclude, I would like to stress that).

bloques.titulo: Follow the thread of an opinion
texto: It identifies the position, the reasons, the contrast, the proposal and the conclusion. Connectors help to rebuild the relationship between ideas; they do not replace the specific reasons for the text.
